text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed 'Quick Shortcuts' in console showing rows from the previous org after an org switch. steps: open org A, add a shortcut, switch to org B, open shortcuts panel -> still see A's entries.

jon: repro? mac/chrome? incognito?

maya: mac, latest chrome. Happens in prod and staging. tried 2 tabs: create in tab1 (org A), switch to org B in tab2, open panel in tab2 and A's entry is visible.

priya: that sounds like our client-side cache or localStorage not being namespaced by org. we have prefetch for shortcuts on route change — maybe prefetch populates store without org context.

sam: seeing similar in prefetch logs. from prefetch-service logs: 
```
2025-06-12T16:11:12Z INFO prefetch-service requestId=abc123 route=/api/internal/shortcuts status=200 org_header="-" user=maya
2025-06-12T16:11:12Z WARN prefetch-service missing org header, falling back to session
```

sam: note the org_header is "-" when the request originates from the edge worker during a fast org swap.

jon: frontend code stores shortcuts here: 
```
localStorage.setItem('shortcuts_v2', JSON.stringify({data, fetchedAt: Date.now()}))
// NO orgId included in key
```

jon: so two problems: prefetch call sometimes doesn't pass org id -> returns previous org's data, and local cache key not namespaced by org. combined -> ghost rows.

lia: ugly but easy mitigation: prefix localStorage key with org id, and invalidate on org switch. also add a guard in prefetch to drop responses if response.org !== currentOrg.

maya: can we toss a small runtime check to avoid showing cached shortcuts if org mismatch? quick patch while we fix prefetch.

priya: agree. patch plan: 1) prefetch-service: require X-Org header for internal calls and log/metric for missing header. 2) frontend: change cache key to `shortcuts:${orgId}:v2` and flush on workspace switch. 3) add e2e that creates a shortcut in org A then rapidly switches to org B and asserts no A rows show.

sam: will add a telemetry counter for missing-org-header (prefetch.missing_org_header) and a rate alert if > 0.1% of requests.

jon: can one of you own the frontend patch? I can do the prefetch-service change.

maya: i'll pick frontend change and e2e. quick convo: for UI runtime guard, i can check response.metadata.orgId or the X-Org echoed header. what do we have in the shortcuts payload?

priya: shortcuts payload includes `ownerOrgId` already. use that. if ownerOrgId !== currentOrg skip rendering. add a dev flag to surface skipped items during debug.

lia: add unit test on the storage module too. edge case: users with cross-org visibilty (platform admins) — ensure we don't drop intentionally visible items. add allowlist check if user has global flag scope_admin.

maya: noted. will include that.

jon: i'll add the header enforcement on the prefetch path and fail-fast with 400 if absent for internal-edge calls. also add a small migration for cached entries on reload (purge old keys without org prefix).

sam: pushed a tiny PR to add metric and log. deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging for prefetch-service change? :

deploy-bot: deployment started for prefetch-service revision r2025-73 -> staging (rollout 10%).

maya: thanks. i'll open a quick PR for the frontend and tag eng-platform for review. assigning to maya for ownership.

priya: looping in UX — we should maybe show a transient banner when switching orgs: "Refreshing shortcuts for new workspace" so users don't get confused.

maya: good idea, i'll add UX banner as optional flag behind feature-toggle.

jon: next steps: prefetch fix (jon), frontend cache key + guard + e2e (maya), metric alert (sam), UX banner (maya + product). aim to have staging by EOD and prod rollback window tomorrow.

maya: adding docs note to console runbook about this class of bug and how to triage (look for prefetch.missing_org_header and localStorage keys).

sam: saw it in a support ticket too. tagging support to watch for similar reports. :thumbsup:

maya: thx all — i'll post PR links here when ready.
